data.name: 隐秘之潮
data.detailed_description:
Think you can outlast the black rain before it eats your mind? Then strike a bargain with the gods, take what was never meant for mortal hands, and shoot your way to the exit through everything the corruption throws at you.

Husk: Occult Tides is a 1 to 3 player roguelike magic-shooter that welds a high-stakes extraction loop onto a wild in-run build system. Every descent reshapes the world beneath you, so no two raids ever look the same. Go in solo or dive with friends, then mix active skills with passive upgrades to twist your shots into screen-filling, trajectory-bending arcane fire. The deeper you push, the more the Black Rain feeds on your SAN. Before it hits zero, you have a choice: hand your haul to the Reaper Merchant for safekeeping, or punch all the way to the end and drag the treasure out yourself.

Forge Forbidden Power

Two parallel build tracks. Endless random rolls of sealed artifacts and relics. Pay in blood and flesh for a glimpse of the abyss's strangest, most ruinous magic, then watch it stack out of control and rewrite how every bullet behaves. No two builds play alike, and the best ones are always the ones you never saw coming.

A Maze That Never Sits Still

The danger zones rearrange themselves every run, dropping you into Isaac-style branching paths under the constant bite of the Black Rain. Rooms are dealt out at random, each with its own threats and its own payoff, and you set the pace. The Rain is forever chewing at your sanity, so every door you open is a bet you place against the abyss.

Loot, Risk, Extract

This is extraction at its most ruthless. Rare weapons, accessories, outfits, and collectibles lie scattered across the map, all yours to keep if you make it out. Die down there and the abyss takes every last item in your pack for free. The only ways home are to find a wandering Reaper Merchant and cash out mid-run, or to fight clean through to the end and walk out the hard way.

Dive Alone or Bring a Crew

Take it on solo for the ultimate test, or squad up with in teams of up to three players for survival shooting where anything can happen. Teammates do more than watch your back. They can sprint through monster-packed rooms to drag a fallen ally back into the fight a stage later. Split off to grab more loot before sanity runs dry if you dare, but whoever ends up alone becomes the easiest prey in the maze.

Cash Out, Gear Up

Everything you carry out stays with you. Back at the black market, fence your collectibles and spare junk for gold, then trade, buy, and kit out with the deadly weapons and outfits you hauled up from below. Walk into your next run already loaded with last run's best gear, ready to tear the mutants apart before they even smell you coming.

data.short_description: Husk: Occult Tides is a dark roguelike shooter for 1 to 3 players. Drop into ever-shifting mutation zones, bargain with the Old Gods for forbidden power, and bend storms of arcane bullets to your will. Carve through the swarm, claim the relics, and extract before the Black Rain devours your mind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win10 64-bit
  • Processor: i3-8100 / R3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-10400 / R5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660S / RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game features frequent cartoon-style violence and blood effects. Players use weapons to defeat mutated fantasy monsters, which includes blood splatters and enemy death animations. Player characters can also die upon failing in combat. The game does not contain any sexual content, realistic gore, or other extreme mature content.
